notes.title: Patch note 0.10.7d
notes.notes:
Once again, we've been hard at work squashing bugs and making our mini-games prettier! Here are all of our efforts resumed in text form!

- Runestones now require fewer ghosts to activate them when playing a match with a lower number of total players.
- Alive players will now hear a creepy sound when a ghost is stalking them, spooky!
- On the Magic Powder mini-game, both players now get the exact same sequence of colours. Balance has been restored to the universe.
- Boneyard mini-game is now less susceptible to auto-clicker attacks. Cheaters are lame.
- The shop now remembers your skin selections at least a little longer than a Goldfish could. (no fish were harmed during this process)
- Made our battle detection ray-tracing better. Mathematical!
- Moved servers to London, you can almost hear Big Ben ringing. Almost.
- A literal "metric butt ton" of mini-game visual effects have been updated, can you spot them all?
- And we also hunted down and fixed lots of bugs thanks to you guys! Keep 'em coming <3

notes.title: Patch note 0.10.7b
notes.notes:
These are all the awesome changes we've made this week:

- Stopped the death freeze overlay from appearing on top of mini-games.
- Stopped your Android from falling alseep on you, zzz.
- Made the tutorial UI prettier and easier to navigate.
- Made the Magic Powder easier to grab.
- The "Apply Settings" button is now more reliable!
- The Enigma mini-game is now more reactive.
- Tweaked animation speed in Twin Runes.
- If you won a mini-game and still died… that should no longer happen, sorry!
- You should encounter less accidental ice-covered rooms when rejoining a lobby for a new match.
- Fixed a bug where the same player could join a lobby twice.
- Added a pop-up to either reconnect to the same lobby or return to the Main Menu after a match, to help with an issue where players who were trapped watching adverts weren't in the lobby when the new match started. Don't leave your friends behind!
- Lots and lots of UI upgrades for PC and Android!
- Mini-game titles are easier to read.
- Players' flames now change size depending on remaining life!
- Doors now close, to dynamically change the map size depending on the number of players.

Have fun!

notes.title: Patch note 0.10.7a
notes.notes:
Gameplay: 
-Players won't be effected by ice after starting a new match
-Android users using touch mode can now interact with the left corner of the screen
-Mini-game screen will no longer shake when a battle is started on ice

UI: 
-Clicking play without a player name will now send you to the correct page
-The graphics quality option is fixed
-Tombstone selection in the shop is fixed
-Android players can no longer open the work-in-progress shop panel

Thank you for your feedback!
